description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) based in the United States . 

 This role offers the opportunity to strengthen software quality across a business-critical post-production automation platform. You will combine hands-on manual testing with automated quality engineering to ensure applications, integrations, and workflows perform reliably throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams, you will help identify risks early, improve test coverage, and accelerate feedback between development and release. You will build reusable testing frameworks, validate complex workflows, investigate defects, and help prevent recurring production issues. The position also contributes to deployment readiness and operational support, including occasional off-hours activities. It is well suited to a quality-focused engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and continuously improving testing practices.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Design and maintain automated tests



 
 Build, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance tests for the post-production automation platform.



 
 Create reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards that support scalable and reliable testing.



 
 Develop test cases covering critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.





 
 Strengthen quality throughout the development lifecycle



 
 Collaborate with Development teams early in the delivery process to review requirements and acceptance criteria for completeness, testability, business risk, and potential workflow impacts.



 
 Identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert suitable cases into repeatable automated tests.



 
 Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is unsuitable or further investigation is required.



 
 Promote consistent quality-engineering practices across development and delivery teams.





 
 Investigate defects and improve reliability



 
 Troubleshoot test failures and application issues, distinguishing between software defects, automation problems, test data issues, and environment-related failures.



 
 Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production incidents.



 
 Translate production issues into regression tests that help prevent recurrence.



 
 Trace problems across user interfaces, APIs, application services, databases, automation frameworks, and infrastructure.





 
 Integrate testing into delivery and deployment



 
 Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates.



 
 Work with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring defect reproduction or additional test coverage.



 
 Provide off-hours operational support when needed, including nightly deployments and incident response.





 
 Monitor and continuously improve quality



 
 Develop and maintain test reports, dashboards, and quality metrics covering test execution, coverage, defects, and application quality.



 
 Identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution speed, automation coverage, and overall quality-engineering processes.



 
 Collaborate across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams to support dependable software delivery.






 Requirements


 
 At least 3 years of experience in QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or a similar role combining manual testing and automation.



 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.



 
 Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.



 
 Practical experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable tools.



 
 Experience with REST API testing and performance testing, including analyzing application behavior under load.



 
 Familiarity with test management platforms such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar tools.



 
 Ability to create and maintain reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for critical business workflows.



 
 Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate failures across application layers and infrastructure.



 
 Experience conducting root cause analysis and developing preventative regression tests based on production defects.



 
 Familiarity with source control management, preferably Git.



 
 Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software builds, and deployment processes.



 
 Ability to read and interpret application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.



 
 Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex problems, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.



 
 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or other iterative software development environments.



 
 Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical and operational stakeholders.




 Preferred qualifications:


 
 Experience with Production Asset Management or Media Asset Management systems.



 
 Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.



 
 Familiarity with testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.



 
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.



 
 Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file transfers, databases, messaging systems, and distributed application components.



 
 Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.



 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams and adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.




 Benefits


 
 Annual salary: $90,000–$105,000.



 
 Fully remote work arrangement, with the position performed from a non-company worksite, typically the employee’s residence.



 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance.



 
 401(k) retirement plan.



 
 Paid leave.



 
 Tuition reimbursement.



 
 Additional employee discounts and perks.



 
 Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
